proofs.text: Write an approval for the address `Rich.LaBarca+purlin@example.com`; verify the only file in the approvals directory is named `RULE-1.<hash8>.rich-labarca-purlin.json` for that rule's triple

reasons: PROOF-12 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: An approval file is named for the rule, the first eight characters of the triple and the approver's slug, the email local part lowercased with every character that is not a letter or a digit replaced by a hyphen

tests.body:
def test_the_name_carries_the_rule_the_triple_and_the_slug(self, proved):
        entry = proved.rule('RULE-1')
        triple = approve_module.triple_for(entry)
        approve_module.write_approval(
            proved.root, 'login', 'RULE-1', 'Rich.LaBarca+purlin@example.com',
            None, None, 'tested', 'low', entry=entry)
        assert proved.approvals() == [
            'RULE-1.%s.rich-labarca-purlin.json' % triple[:8]]
tests.name: test_the_name_carries_the_rule_the_triple_and_the_slug
